column1: # Life Dashboard Companion webhook key -> androidx Health Connect Record class -> catalogue metric.
# Connect on an Android phone and POSTs JSON to a receiver. Its keys are snake_case names it chose,
# not androidx class names, so this file is the seam between its payload and health_connect.tsv.
#   34 record keys plus the daily_totals block; every key in that document has a row here.
#   ldc_field   the field inside a record, verbatim; `stages:<name>` is a sleep stage and `session`
#               the sleep session itself; empty when the key is declined as a whole
#   hc_class    the androidx Record class; where health_connect.tsv has the class the two must agree
#   hc_field    the androidx field or constant; informative
#   metric      the catalogue name (res/catalog/metrics.tsv); EMPTY IS A DECLINE and `reason` says why
#   src_unit    the UCUM unit LDC states for the field. The TARGET unit is never written here: it is
#               metrics.METRICS[metric].unit_ucum, so this table cannot disagree with the aggregator
#   time        instant (`time`), interval (`start_time`/`end_time`), session (sleep) or day (daily_totals)
#   gate        `reproductive` = decoded only when the caller passes accept_reproductive
#   reason      the refusal code for a decline: no-metric
# A decline is an explicit row, never an omission: the decoder counts it and does not guess a
# neighbouring metric. An LDC key that is not in this file is refused as unmapped-key.
